Third-party files served from CartLess Checkout's own site, so the shop works on networks that block
public CDNs (unpkg.com, cdnjs, Google Fonts):
  html5-qrcode.min.js   html5-qrcode 2.3.8 (camera barcode/QR scanner)  - Apache-2.0, LICENSE-html5-qrcode.txt
  qrcode.min.js         qrcodejs 1.0.0 (draws bill / token / UPI QR codes) - MIT, LICENSE-qrcodejs.txt
  fonts/*.woff2         Plus Jakarta Sans variable font (latin, latin-ext)  - SIL OFL 1.1, fonts/OFL.txt
